title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Failed Delivery Attempts, Rebooking and Redelivery Fees
content:
When a Northgate Delivery & Installation crew cannot complete an attempt, it logs the failure reason on its handheld and the appointment's status becomes attempt failed. Each dispatch of the crew adds one to the appointment's attempt count.

## Rebooking a failed delivery

1. **Deadline.** A failed delivery is rebooked only when the new date is booked no later than the service level's rebooking deadline, in calendar days after the date of the failed attempt. Days are counted as calendar days, the date of the failed attempt being day 0. The date of the failed attempt is the delivery date the appointment was booked for when the attempt failed. A rebooking made on the last day of the deadline is within it.
2. **Attempts.** A failed delivery is rebooked only while the attempt count is below the service level's attempts before cancellation.
3. **New date.** The new date follows the service level's booking lead times measured from the rebooking date.
4. **Redelivery fee.** When the logged reason is one of the service level's member-caused reasons, the rebooking is charged the level's redelivery fee as a redelivery fee entry whose service date is the failed date. A failure for merchandise damaged on the truck or for carrier delay is Northgate's and is rebooked free.

| Logged reason | Rebooking charged |
|---|---|
| A member-caused reason of the level | The redelivery fee |
| Merchandise damaged on the truck | Free |
| Carrier delay | Free |

## Cancellation of an undelivered appointment

A failed appointment not rebooked by the deadline, or whose attempts have reached the attempts before cancellation, is cancelled and its merchandise returned to the club. Its fees are then credited under the cancellation rules as if cancelled without notice when the last failure was member-caused, and in full otherwise.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical deadline of 7 calendar days)

| Failed attempt | Rebooking made on | Day count | Within the deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3rd of the month | 10th | Day 7 | Yes |
| 3rd of the month | 11th | Day 8 | No |
| 3rd of the month | 3rd | Day 0 | Yes |

With 2 attempts before cancellation (hypothetical), an appointment whose attempt count is 1 may be rebooked; one whose count is 2 has reached the limit.
